title: Full Stack Engineer
description: We are looking for a Full Stack Engineer with strong React, Next.js, GraphQL, and Node.js skills to develop and improve our digital commerce applications. Our technology stack includes React, Next.js, Node.js, GraphQL, commercetools, Storyblok and Storybook . What you’ll do Build and maintain frontend applications using React and Next.js. Develop backend functionality and integrations using Node.js. Integrate APIs and services through GraphQL and REST. Deliver commerce and content experiences using commercetools and Storyblok. Build, document, and maintain reusable UI components using Storybook. Collaborate with the team to deliver reliable, maintainable solutions. What we’re looking for At least 5 years of professional software development experience . Strong hands-on experience with React, Next.js, and Node.js . Practical experience with GraphQL , API consumption, and service integrations. Ability to work across both frontend and backend development. Excellent English communication skills in speaking, reading, and writing . Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to take ownership of your work. Nice to have Experience with commercetools or other headless commerce platforms. Experience with Storyblok or other headless CMS platforms. Experience with Storybook and shared component libraries. Location requirement This is a hybrid role based in Istanbul . Applicants must currently reside in Istanbul and be available to work on-site as required. Applications from candidates residing outside Istanbul will not be considered.
